info.name: Vacation Management API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint, grouped by persona, plus a folder of deliberate rule violations.

1. Start the API (`npm run dev`) and seed the database (`npm run db:seed`).
2. Import this collection and the "Vacation Management - Local" environment, and select the environment.
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (in order), or run requests one by one starting with the Authentication folder.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Log in as each demo persona. Tokens are saved automatically into the environment.

exec: const plus = (days) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + days); return fmt(d); };
